content: Great men are they who see that spiritual is stronger than any material force; that thoughts rule the world.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Physical armies, skyscrapers, and financial empires are all secondary manifestations of immaterial ideas. The unseen realms of conviction and thought forge historical reality.
practicalInsight: Guard the quality of your thoughts fiercely; they are the architectural blueprints of your physical life.
reflectionPrompt: What dominant thought or belief is governing the trajectory of your daily life?
